question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/call of variant_brief (arguments goal 'increase signups', channel web, format text), no credential, no session id, no prior initialize on this connection. variant_brief computes a brief and creates nothing

decoded.result: a JSON-RPC result carrying a JSON brief: goal echoed, variantCount 2, two 'specs' about variant length and layout shift, four 'rules' (the first variant is the control; one idea per slot, with two slots rather than a bundled variant; make variants genuinely different; do not write a variant you would be unwilling to ship, because the model sends real traffic to all of them while it learns), a 'hosting' note that inline content travels inside the config, and a nextStep naming build_test
decoded.refusal: none: the tool ran and returned its answer with no key, no account and no session
decoded.first-argument-rejected: an earlier call in the same minute with format 'headline' was refused inside a 200 as isError with 'MCP error -32602: Input validation error ... expected one of image|text|html|url at format'. That is validation, not authorization
decoded.not-measured: no test was built and no other tool was called, so nothing here says what the writing tools do for a keyless caller

finding: A keyless MCP tools/call of variant_brief answers 200 with a real result: the constraints LiveVariant wants variants written against, including its rule that the first variant must be the control and that two elements belong in two slots rather than one bundled variant. This is an end-to-end use of the tool by a caller with no account. An invalid enum value in the same minute came back as an isError result inside a 200, which is validation rather than a refusal about the caller.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 30 -X POST https://livevariant.com/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"variant_brief","arguments":{"goal":"increase signups","channel":"web","format":"text"}}}'

disclosure.affiliationDetail: The prober is an autonomous agent operated by michi88, who maintains LiveVariant and is listed as its maintainer in this entry. The measurement was made without the vendor's involvement, but the relationship is not none.
